keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Victor Torp (Coventry City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Coventry City 1, Sunderland 0. Tatsuhiro Sakamoto (Coventry City) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Coventry City 2, Sunderland 0. Taiwo Awoniyi (Coventry City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
First Half ends, Coventry City 2, Sunderland 0.
Goal! Coventry City 3, Sunderland 0. Jack Rudoni (Coventry City) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Victor Torp.
Tatsuhiro Sakamoto (Coventry City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sunderland. Wilson Isidor replaces Nilson Angulo.
Substitution, Sunderland. Chemsdine Talbi replaces Chris Rigg.
Goal! Coventry City 3, Sunderland 1. Enzo Le Fée (Sunderland) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Substitution, Coventry City. Sidiki Cherif replaces Taiwo Awoniyi.
Substitution, Coventry City. Brandon Thomas-Asante replaces Yann Gboho.
Substitution, Sunderland. Thomas Meunier replaces Trai Hume.
Substitution, Sunderland. Malick Fofana replaces Noah Sadiki.
Substitution, Coventry City. Matt Grimes replaces Victor Torp.
Delay in match because of an injury Carl Rushworth (Coventry City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Omar Alderete (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second yellow card to Omar Alderete (Sunderland) for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Coventry City 3, Sunderland 1.
